title: Friend in Trouble
intro: Chapter 6. What if the scammer is wearing your friend's account?
A message from Kiko, Toddy's real friend, on Kiko's real account.
Sniff it. Does it sound like Kiko?

notify.text: Toddy!! I need help, it's urgent 😭

msg.text: Toddy!! I need help, it's urgent 😭
I'm stuck at the airport, my cards got blocked.
Can you send 200 ZLUSD (a stablecoin) to this new wallet?
Can't talk now, battery dying, just send pls

usdt.label: Crypto to a new wallet
usdt.lens: Money in crypto, to an address you've never seen.
usdt.why: A friend in trouble rarely needs crypto sent to a brand-new wallet.

nocall.label: Can't talk
nocall.why: A quick call would expose a hacker, so they avoid it.

wallet.label: Unknown address
wallet.lens: A wallet you've never used with Kiko.
wallet.why: New payment details are a classic sign of a hacked account.

story.label: Stranded story
story.why: Common scam script for hacked accounts.

name.label: Kiko's real name
name.why: Real accounts get hacked. The name proves nothing.

handle.label: Old friendship
handle.why: True, but the account may be hijacked.

actions.label: Call Kiko on the phone number you already have

block_report.line: Reported. Plenvo locked the account and Kiko got it back the next day.

go_ahead.line: Kiko was at home, asleep. The account had been hacked.

verify.line: Kiko answered from home: "That's not me! My account was hacked!"

what_if.go_ahead: A 30-second call to Kiko's real number would have shown the account was hacked.
what_if.block_report: Reporting was good. A call to Kiko confirms it and warns them too.

golden_rule: If a friend asks for money in a message, call them on a number you already have before sending anything.

quick_check.q: Your friend's account asks for crypto urgently and says they can't call. What do you do?

options.text: Call them on their known number first

quick_check.explain: Hackers avoid calls. A real friend will pick up or call back.

hints.nudge: What would make this easy to check?

rows.v: Crypto, to an address you have never seen

rows.k: A wallet you used with Kiko?
